audio_description:
The camera travels down a vaulted stone passage toward an ornate iron gate.
The parade gateway's glowing geometric mechanism is revealed.
Figures, including Zell, stand on the great gate; Edea presides from her throne.
An overhead shot shows the gate, braziers and a glowing magic circle.
The vast crowd fills Deling City at night.

context.scene_title: The Deling City parade gateway — the magical spectacle and gate mechanism during the Sorceress assassination mission (Disc 1).
locations: Deling City — an arched stone tunnel/passage leading to the ornate parade gate, the gateway's glowing Art-Deco mechanism, and an overhead view of the floodlit parade plaza

characters.name: Sorceress Edea
characters.recognition: Seen on the central red throne/dais of the gate with her golden radial-web headdress; the focus of the parade.

characters.name: Zell Dincht
characters.recognition: Spiky blond hair, checkered/plaid trousers, white sneakers, sleeveless top — visible standing on the gate structure.

characters.name: (second figure on the gate)
characters.recognition: A light-haired figure in a long coat stands opposite Zell; likely one of the SeeD party operating the gate, not clearly identifiable.

context.summary: The camera travels down a vaulted stone passage to an ornate iron gate, then reveals the parade gateway's glowing geometric mechanism. Figures (including Zell) stand on the great gate as Edea presides from her throne; a sweeping overhead shot shows the gate, braziers, a glowing magic circle and the vast crowd filling Deling City at night.
context.context_note: High confidence this is the Deling City parade-gate sequence of the assassination mission; the second gate figure is not positively identified.
